full_judgment: 22. As the suit lands are not included in the list of Enemy. Properties, at present Vested Pioperties, under section 9(1) or as per the sub-section 6 of the section 9 of Arpito Sampatti Pratyarpan Ain (Act No.23 of 2011), the same are not vested properties. Government is estopped by law from claiming it to be vested property. And the private party-respondents no. 10-15 who are claiming through Government as lessees not at the strength of vested property. It is to be noted further that the Government followed the procedure laid down in section 92 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 to treat and take over the property earlier vide Miscellaneous Case No.354/8/60-61 and another Miscellaneous Case No.770/8/60-61 thereby followed the procedure to take over the property and leased out the same as khas land. So, the first ground does not come to play, rather, this ground is nugatory.
